messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: bootstrap
parts:
We are generally lacking in documentation of ways to write ui.R but here is an example of using Bootstrap:

shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  tags$div(class="container",
    tags$div(class="span6",
      "Hello"),
    tags$div(class="span6",
      "Goodbye")
  )
))

You can generate any HTML tag by calling tags$tagname as a function, where the named arguments become attributes and unnamed arguments become children. The children can be other tag$tagname calls, strings (which are then HTML-escaped), unescaped HTML strings (like this: HTML("<strong>This is bold text</strong>") ), and lists containing any of the above (and other lists).

If you get tired of typing "tags$" all the time, check out the withTags function.

There is also includeHTML, includeScript, includeCSS, and includeText which can also be mixed in with the above.
